column2: PHP CP CMS installer: registers content, content_access and control_items rows and lang strings for the PHP CP, builds PHP CP URLs and rebinds the PHP PDO link. ASP.NET serves Document Control from code routes (/cp/document-control-app via CpShopModuleRouteMap and CpNavTree), creates its schema with ErpDocumentControlRender.EnsureAsync, and opens tenant connections through ITenantDbConnectionFactory, so none of it applies.

Unreferenced predecessor of smsaero/send_sms.php: no operator row, CP page or caller posts to send_sms_old.php, and it targets SMS Aero's retired v1 gate (/send/ with an md5 password). The live smsaero handler (v2 /v2/sms/send with basic auth) is ported in CpSmsLegacyOperators and served at its PHP URL.

Unreferenced library: no PHP file includes it or calls any of its epc_rf_* functions, and nothing else reads the reg_fields columns it would add (field_category, available_for_approval, for_customer_approval, for_vendor_approval, compliance_tag). Its seed pack and approval checklist were never wired to a CP page, so there is no behaviour to port.

PHP deploy probe: require_onces config.php, dp_user.php and six price engine libraries one by one and echoes each step (with the document root, and the file and line of a failure) as JSON, to find which PHP include breaks ajax_auto_price.php. ASP.NET has no include chain (the price engine is compiled and wired through DI, so a missing piece fails the build or startup), and its liveness is /health. The probe also discloses server paths to anyone, so it is not ported.
